name: io.github.Pantheonn3D/cuecaps-mcp
title: Cuecaps
description: Animated word-by-word captions for your video and audio files, rendered on your machine by Cuecaps.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: Lists the 18 Cuecaps caption styles: the id to pass as style to studio_link, the name, how each one looks, and whether it is a Creator style (any plan previews it; exporting a video with it needs Creator). Call it when the user hasn't picked a style or asks what the styles look like.

tools.name: studio_link
tools.description: Returns a link to the Cuecaps studio set up exactly as the user described: the style, font, colors, how the spoken word stands out, the animation, size, format and language, plus a summary of what it sets up and the steps to give the user: they open it, add their video, click Find words and export an MP4 with captions burned in, a transparent overlay or an SRT or VTT file. With fast, the link also turns on Fast edit as soon as the words are found, cutting dead space, filler words and retakes, punching in on the jump cuts and levelling the volume. The video stays on their device. Works on every plan, Free included; exporting with Fast edit comes with Creator and Pro.

style.description: Caption style. list_styles shows how each one looks.

words.description: Words per caption; 1 shows one word at a time.

position.description: Where the captions sit in the frame.

aspect.description: Frame shape: 9:16 for TikTok, Shorts and Reels, 1:1 or 4:5 for feed posts, 16:9 for YouTube.

lang.description: The spoken language. Give it for any video that isn't in English; auto lets cloud transcription detect it.

fast.description: Fast edit tools to turn on once the words are found: deadspace cuts the pauses, fillers cuts um, uh and stutters, retakes keeps the last take of a restarted sentence, zoom punches in on the jump cuts, norm levels the volume to -14 LUFS. all turns on every one.

voice.description: true removes background noise, music and room sound from the voice once the words are found (Clean up voice, a Fast edit tool; runs on the graphics card in Chrome or Edge on a computer).

font.description: Caption font, in place of the style's own.

color.description: Text color: a hex value such as #FFFFFF, or white, black, yellow, gold, orange, red, pink, purple, blue, cyan, green, lime.

highlight.description: Color of the word being spoken, as a hex value or a color name. A style that doesn't color the spoken word starts to.

emphasis.description: Color of the key words the studio picks for emphasis, as a hex value or a color name.

mark.description: How the spoken word stands out: color it, a box behind it, grow it, dim the words not yet spoken, reveal words as they are spoken, or none.

anim.description: How each caption comes in: pop, punch (slams down from large), bounce, rise, slide, fade, focus (from a blur), typewriter (letter by letter) or none.

case.description: Letter case: upper for capitals, lower, or as-spoken.

size.description: Caption size as a percent of the style's own: 125 for bigger, 80 for smaller.
